artifacts.summary: Research for commands/merge.md --stack/--only/--retarget mode: confirms file_scope excludes the duplicated Phase 4 (restack) paragraph, documents the manifest JSON schema, shows the platform refusal and push-grant revocation are already discharged by existing calls, and flags that skill-git-workflow/SKILL.md needs no edit for this deliverable.

memory_candidates.content: agent-system/extensions/core/commands/merge.md's existing STEP 4 Cancel handler already revokes the prompt-minted push grant via 'bash .claude/scripts/git-push-granted.sh --revoke' (not by sourcing scripts/lib/push-grant-lib.sh directly). Any new mode of /merge that needs to revoke a grant without pushing should reuse this exact call rather than re-deriving a lower-level path.

review-stack-prepare.sh's documented RESOLUTION phase (integration branch -> review base PD1 -> remote -> platform PD9) runs before EVERY subcommand body, including 'show'. A single 'show --stack-id NAME --json' call therefore discharges both manifest-reading and platform-refusal in one step for any caller -- no separate platform check needs to be hand-rolled by a caller.

review-stack-prepare.sh's manifest entries[] array is already written in final bottom-up stack order by rsp_cut_plan (ordinal increments per unit in final order); a consumer need not re-sort it. The manifest's 'ordinal' field is a bare JSON integer, while the zero-padded 'NN' a user types (e.g. for a --only NN flag) appears only in branch/body_path strings (%02d-formatted) -- comparing user input to ordinal requires stripping leading zeros first, not a literal string match.
